from pathlib import Path
prog_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    """Place four rotations of the input in a 2x2 arrangement."""
    a = [list(row) for row in grid]
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    half = [row[:] + right for row, right in zip(a, cw)]
    bottom = [left + right for left, right in zip(ccw, [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])][::-1])]
    return half + bottom
'''
# correct 180 rotation: reverse both row and col, compute clearly
source='''def transform(grid):
    """Tile the input with its clockwise, counterclockwise, and 180-degree rotations."""
    a = [list(row) for row in grid]
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*a[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*a)][::-1]
    half = [row + rotated for row, rotated in zip(a, cw)]
    bottom = [rotated + reversed_row for rotated, reversed_row in zip(ccw, [row[::-1] for row in a[::-1]])]
    return half + bottom
'''
